response.sql: WITH j AS (SELECT o.ordertune AS t FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark), c AS (SELECT t, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM j GROUP BY t), s AS (SELECT t, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT t, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess FROM a WHERE share > avg_share

assumptions.assumption: The average share across all order types is the mean of the per-group shares (including the NULL group), which equals 1/number of groups; the NULL ordertune group counts as one type.
Orders.recordvault is unique, so the inner join does not duplicate executions beyond one per execution record.
